# Le Cong Hoan

> Full-stack Engineer based in Hanoi, Vietnam, specializing in Angular Micro-frontends, Next.js, Java Spring Boot microservices, high-scale database workflows (Oracle, PostgreSQL), automated CI/CD pipelines, and multi-node Kubernetes (K3s) Homelab infrastructure. Born April 2, 2002. Graduated with an Engineer Degree in Information Technology with Distinction from the University of Transport and Communications (UTC).

Le Cong Hoan is a Full-stack Engineer and System Builder experienced in developing enterprise process automation systems (EPAS) and high-performance web applications.

## Technical Notes & Articles

- [Designing Angular Micro-Frontends for Enterprise Applications](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/angular-microfrontend-architecture): How to structure Nx monorepos, module federation, shared UI libraries, and synchronized routing across independent enterprise teams.
- [Building a 3-Node Kubernetes (K3s) Homelab with Longhorn Storage](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/kubernetes-homelab-k3s): Hands-on architectural setup for bare-metal multi-node K3s, Longhorn distributed block storage, Traefik ingress, and local deployment pipelines.
- [Building a Practical CI/CD Pipeline: From Git to Kubernetes](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/practical-cicd-jenkins-k8s): A battle-tested Jenkins declarative pipeline featuring multi-stage Docker builds, layer caching, automated versioning, and zero-downtime rolling updates.
- [Preserving Complex Filter & Pagination State in Angular Applications](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/angular-complex-list-state): Managing enterprise data grid states with RxJS declarative streams, bi-directional URL query sync, and seamless browser history navigation.
- [PostgreSQL & Oracle in Enterprise Systems: Architecture & SQL Tuning](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/postgresql-oracle-migration-lessons): Architectural insights on dual-persistence patterns, indexing strategies, connection pooling, and optimizing high-throughput SQL queries with Spring Boot.
- [Reflections on Graduating as an IT Engineer (Distinction) & Transitioning to Production Systems](https://hoan.io.vn/writing/from-utc-engineer-to-production-systems): Personal and technical reflections on graduating with distinction from UTC, computer science fundamentals, and stepping into enterprise engineering.

## Featured Systems & Projects

- [EPAS — Enterprise Process Automation System](https://hoan.io.vn/#selected-work): Enterprise-scale micro-frontend and microservice platform with CRM/BPM workflow automation built on Angular, Nx, Spring Boot, Kafka, Keycloak, and Kubernetes.
- [Enterprise CI/CD & Kubernetes Homelab Infrastructure](https://hoan.io.vn/#selected-work): Automated container pipelines, private registry, Longhorn distributed storage, and multi-node K3s cluster orchestration.
- [Zalo OA Integration & Message Management Platform](https://hoan.io.vn/#selected-work): Enterprise communication console for conversation filtering, broadcast template administration, and Spring Boot REST integration.
- [MochiMochi Language Learning Platform](https://hoan.io.vn/#selected-work): Learner-facing web applications with Next.js App Router, Core Web Vitals optimization, and modular TypeScript components.
